compliance: Pinus plants for planting need a UK plant passport as a regulated host of pine pests.
cvs: 'Banshosho' – very dwarf, bun-shaped · 'Oculus Draconis' – yellow-banded 'dragon's eye' needles · 'Kotobuki' – narrow upright dwarf
foliage: evergreen; long stiff dark green needles in pairs
hardinessNote: Fully hardy in the UK, below -20°C (RHS H7).
pollination: not applicable; conifer grown for foliage and form, not fruit
prune: Optional: snap or cut new candles back by about half in late spring to keep it dense. Do not cut into bare old wood, as it will not regrow.
resilience: Wind, salt-spray and drought tolerant once established. Pests: pine sawfly, adelgids, aphids.
sources: RHS 115367 (Pinus thunbergii 'Thunderhead'), search snippet: AGM, H7, 4–8 × 1.5–2.5 m in 20–50 years, full sun, well-drained loam or sand, drought resistant
toxicity: Resinous sap may irritate sensitive skin. Wear gloves when pinching candles or pruning.
